title: Tip from Angela - The 20 Minute Method
summary: A study-habit tip: commit to only 20 minutes of work on the course when motivation is low, because starting is the hard part and momentum usually carries on afterwards.

concepts.heading: The 20 minute method
points: Skills come from consistent practice, but tiredness and competing distractions make it hard to begin a session.
Set a small commitment: study for just 20 minutes, then you are free to stop and do something else.
Starting is the main obstacle. Once underway, people tend to carry on, so sessions often run longer than planned.
If you stop at 20 minutes anyway, that is still real progress.
Use it on evenings or mornings when the course feels overwhelming.
